product.name: VotingWorks Voting Machines
product.description: An open-source voting system that allows voters to mark, verify, and cast paper ballots by hand or using a ballot marking device, designed to meet VVSG 2.0 standards.

product.name: VotingWorks Post-Election Audits
product.description: An open-source auditing tool that enables election officials to verify election results by hand counting a sample of paper ballots, supporting traditional and risk-limiting audits.
